usedFor: Voodoo SMS manages contact lists, and “Add Contact” and “Create Contact List” build them, starting from “New Contact Added”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Blacklisted Number” in Voodoo SMS, then “Receive Incoming Message” in Quo
bestTemplate.why: A blacklisted number is caught on its own, so you can react when a number is blocked.

watchOut: “New Blacklisted Number” is polling, so it is checked on a schedule and arrives with a short delay.
